intro.text: Lunamor and Tuaka's third son, who by Horneater tradition has the honour of being a craftsman.

items.text: Star reached the Shattered Plains with his family after months of travel. Voidbringers attacked their caravan, and the family held out behind a pile of furniture until Bridge Four found them and took them to Urithiru. There Star helped his father serve food and drink to Bridge Four.
Soon after the people of Hearthstone were evacuated, Star went back to the Peaks with most of his family; only Cord and Gift stayed behind.
